description: A weekend in Paris: Is Thomas telling the truth?

questions.question: Thanks for helping me… Can you confirm this phone really belongs to Thomas? Give me his full name please.
questions.hint: Check in Contacts or profile info, you'll easily find Thomas's last name.

questions.question: Great, that's him. Can you check the Messages app and tell me if you find a shady conversation please? If yes, give me the contact name.
questions.hint: In the Messages app, look for a suspicious contact name, you can read the messages to see if there's something shady...

questions.question: Hmm… interesting. Tell me, what does he call this person? Did he give them a nickname? Which one?
questions.hint: Look for nicknames in the conversation with 'Do not answer'

questions.question: Okay, things are getting clearer… Do you know how Thomas and this "So" met? Through which app?
questions.hint: In the messages with Do not answer, look for any mention of a dating app.

questions.question: Now I need as much info as possible on this contact. Did they meet up in real life? If yes, what kind of place was it?
questions.hint: In the messages, check if they're meeting up somewhere or if they talk about a place where they met.

questions.question: What's the name of that restaurant? Search through all his apps, please.
questions.hint: In the calendar, check the date when they met for their restaurant. There's an address, you should be able to find the restaurant on Google Maps.

questions.question: Great… In which city did Thomas spend the night he stopped replying to me? He went silent on me that evening.
questions.hint: Check past Airbnb reservations on the date when Thomas wasn't responding.

questions.question: Wait, did Thomas ALSO pay to spend the night with "So"? If yes, how much did he pay?
questions.hint: Check the bank transactions in the Wallet app, his Revolut card.

questions.question: And what excuse did Thomas give me for not calling that evening while he was in Versailles? Remind me please.
questions.hint: Read the messages exchanged with Julia that evening.

questions.question: You know what… He must be hiding photos. Try to find the password to his hidden photos and give it to me please.
questions.hint: Look for a clue about the code in Notes.

questions.question: There, I knew it… Now that you’ve seen her face, can you find “So”’s last name for me please?
questions.hint: Now that you know her face, search Instagram for a profile starting with So. Be careful, it's not Sofia Sancho, search in her followers instead!

questions.question: Okay… And how old is this girl?
questions.hint: Calculate using her birth year which you'll find in her Instagram username.

questions.question: Of course… And where does this Sophie live?
Great… and do you know where she works?
questions.hint: Look in the comments on her Instagram posts, there's a colleague's profile there.

questions.question: That’s it… Why did he go looking elsewhere? How does he justify it?
questions.hint: Check the messages with his buddy Mehdi.

onboardingContent.text:
I was told you're the perfect person to stalk.
So... I need you.

I've been with Thomas for three years. Three years of laughter, trips, shared plans...
We were talking about marriage, a house, kids. It was supposed to be perfect.

But everything changed after his so-called business trip to Paris.
He barely replied to my messages... and since then I can't stop doubting.
My gut tells me he's hiding something.

So yeah... I made a crazy decision: I'm giving you a clone of his phone.
You'll have access to everything: his messages, his notes, his apps... everything.
I'll ask you questions while you stalk his phone. Your move.
